# iDataGear — full app reference

> iDataGear Inc (Intelligence Data Gear) makes McLearn® language apps and everyday tools for iPhone, iPad, Android and the web, from Toronto, Canada and Hong Kong. McLearn® is iDataGear's registered trademark for its language apps. Every figure below is a count of what ships inside the app.

## McChinese — Learn Chinese (HSK 1–6)

Also known as: Learn Chinese, McChinese HSK (Google Play), McChinese - HSK Chinese (App Store).

Mandarin from the first character to HSK 6, with pinyin and audio on every word.

- HSK vocabulary: HSK 1 500 words, HSK 2 772, HSK 3 974, HSK 4 1,000, HSK 5 1,071, HSK 6 1,149
- Grade 1–6: 1,530 elementary-school words that HSK leaves out
- 1,988 example sentences graded by HSK level, each with audio
- 33 graded articles, played sentence by sentence
- 309 reading-comprehension test questions across HSK 1–3
- Four mini-games: Tone Trainer, Timed Quiz, Listening Match and Sentence Match
- Pinyin drills, animated stroke order, flash cards and spaced-repetition review
- Meanings in English, Spanish, Japanese, Korean or Vietnamese
- No account; progress, favourites and settings stay on the device

Links:
- Guide and video: https://www.idatagear.com/chinese/
- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/chinese/learnchinese/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mcchinese-hsk-chinese/id6804361040
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.learn_chinese
- Promo video: https://www.idatagear.com/assets/video/chinese/learnchinese-promo.mp4
- Privacy: https://www.idatagear.com/chinese/chinese_privacy.html
- Support: https://www.idatagear.com/chinese/chinese_contactus.html

## McCantonese — Learn Cantonese (識聽識講 廣東話)

Also known as: Learn Cantonese, McLearn® - Learn Cantonese (Google Play), McCantonese - Learn Cantonese (App Store).

Cantonese as it is actually spoken in Hong Kong and Guangzhou, with Jyutping on every entry.

- Interactive Jyutping guide: 19 initials, the finals and all six tones, with audio
- Jyutping practice that breaks characters into initial, final and tone
- Speaking practice scored with the device's speech recognition
- 12,116 Hong Kong slang entries with meanings and examples
- 3,146 phrases, 2,167 characters, 1,398 daily sentences, 680 popular words
- 209 dialogues played back as a chat, 274 mini stories, 20 articles
- 472 reduplications, 142 Three Character Classic couplets, 120 Gen Z slang terms, 95 children's songs, 71 tongue twisters
- 340+ entries of Guangzhou dialect collections
- The whole library is stored on the device, so it works offline
- Audio uses the device's Cantonese text-to-speech voice and never falls back to Mandarin

Links:
- Guide and video: https://www.idatagear.com/cantonese/
- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/cantonese/learncantonese/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mccantonese-learn-cantonese/id6797105973
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.learn_cantonese
- Promo video: https://www.idatagear.com/assets/video/cantonese/mccantonese-promo.mp4
- Privacy: https://www.idatagear.com/cantonese/cantonese_privacy.html
- Support: https://www.idatagear.com/cantonese/cantonese_contactus.html

## McEnglish — ALL English (CEFR A1–C2)

Also known as: ALL English - All Levels (Google Play), McEnglish - Learn English (App Store), All Level Learner's English.

English organised by CEFR level from A1 to C2.

- Words with IPA by level: A1 895, A2 858, B1 802, B2 1,425, C1 1,299, C2 788 (8,000+ in total)
- Collections: Basic 850, Oxford 3000, Common 2198, VOA 1510, IELTS, CET-4, CET-6
- Graded sentences and articles, timed level tests
- Speaking practice with speech recognition
- Two hands-free auto-play modes: Memorize Words and Ear Training
- Interface and meanings in English, Chinese, Spanish or Arabic (right-to-left supported)

Links:
- Guide and video: https://www.idatagear.com/english/
- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/english/learnenglish/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mcenglish-learn-english/id6801781337
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.learn_english
- Promo video: https://www.idatagear.com/assets/video/english/allenglish-promo.mp4
- Privacy: https://www.idatagear.com/english/english_privacy.html
- Support: https://www.idatagear.com/english/english_contactus.html

## Great Cantonese Dictionary (粵語大詞典)

A complete offline Cantonese reference.

- 71,655 words, phrases and expressions, each with Jyutping and tap-to-hear pronunciation
- Search four ways: Chinese characters (你好), Jyutping (nei5 hou2), English, or Mandarin; search also matches listed synonyms
- The full dictionary is built into the app: nothing to download, no connection needed
- Collections: Popular Words, Hong Kong Gen Z Slang (120 terms), a seven-part Guangzhou Dialect Collection, Reduplication (472 AABB and ABB expressions), Tongue Twisters (71), Children's Songs (95) and the Three Character Classic (142 couplets)
- A Jyutping guide (19 initials, 53 finals and the tones) and a grammar section
- Favourites, search history, a word of the day and a daily streak
- Interface in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese

Links:
- Guide and video: https://www.idatagear.com/gcd/guide/
- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/gcd/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/great-cantonese-dictionary/id6799552060
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.great_cantonese_dictionary
- Promo video: https://www.idatagear.com/assets/video/gcd/gcd-promo.mp4
- Privacy: https://www.idatagear.com/gcd/gcd_privacy.html

## Chinese Xie Zi (写字板 / 中文寫字板)

Learn to write Chinese characters, not just recognise them.

- Trace any character with real-time stroke feedback: correct strokes are accepted, wrong ones rejected
- Animated stroke order from authentic stroke data
- 9,500+ characters and radicals, each with pinyin and an English meaning
- Decomposition into radicals and components; Simplified and Traditional counterparts side by side
- Grouped by HSK 1–6, HSK 7–9 and radicals, with a random-character mode
- Tap to hear any character read aloud
- Favourites and practice history on the device; no account or sign-up
- A character traced once is cached and works with no connection

Links:
- Guide and video: https://www.idatagear.com/xiezi/guide/
- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/xiezi/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chinese-xie-zi-%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87%E5%AF%AB%E5%AD%97%E6%9D%BF/id6806851205
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.xiezi
- Promo video (Simplified): https://www.idatagear.com/assets/video/xiezi/xiezi-promo-zh-hans.mp4
- Promo video (Traditional): https://www.idatagear.com/assets/video/xiezi/xiezi-promo-zh-hant.mp4
- Privacy: https://www.idatagear.com/xiezi/xiezi_privacy.html

## QuickOne Scanner: PDF & OCR

A document scanner that runs entirely on the device.

- Automatic page-edge detection, multi-page capture, retake and reorder; photo import through the system picker
- Crop and Original, Grayscale or Black & white filters; the original is never overwritten
- On-device text recognition for Latin scripts and for Simplified and Traditional Chinese, with automatic script detection
- Full-text search across titles and every recognized word; type # to filter by tag
- 17 built-in tags plus your own, colour-coded folders
- Sign with a finger in five ink colours, add sticky notes
- Export as a PDF with a searchable text layer, an images-only PDF, JPEG per page, plain text, or a ZIP of the library
- Interface in English, French, Spanish, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
- Nothing is uploaded: iDataGear runs no server for the app, and there is no account
- iOS 15.5 or later; Android 7.0 or later

Links:
- Guide: https://www.idatagear.com/quickonescanner/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/quickone-scanner-pdf-ocr/id6801050269
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.quickonescanner
- Privacy: https://www.idatagear.com/quickonescanner/quickonescanner_privacy.html

---

## Momera GO (拾光旅行)

From where you go, to memory forever.

- Record a hike with GPS that keeps running with the screen locked and no signal
- Photos, videos, voice memos and notes, pinned to the spot on the route
- Replay a hike on the map, with moments appearing as the replay reaches them; export the replay as an MP4 on Android
- Build a journey from a Google Maps Timeline export or from geotagged photos, with each leg coloured by mode of transport
- Import and follow GPX trails; Hike Back turns the route walked into a route home
- Street and outdoor basemaps; areas you have viewed are kept for offline use
- No account or sign-up; hikes, media and journeys are stored on the phone
- English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese

Links:
- Guide and video: https://www.idatagear.com/momerago/ (also https://www.idatagear.com/momerago/zh-cn.html and https://www.idatagear.com/momerago/zh-tw.html)
- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/hiking/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/momera-go/id6811666343
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.momera.hiking
- Promo video: https://www.idatagear.com/assets/video/momerago/momerago-promo-en.mp4
- Privacy: https://www.idatagear.com/momerago/momerago_privacy.html

---

## McMuse: Photo to Art

Turns a photo you already have into a new piece of art: the whole frame is re-rendered in the chosen style, not filtered.

- 51 styles: 16 art styles (3D Animation, Digital Painting, Oil Painting, Watercolor, Acrylic Painting, Chinese Ink Wash, Pencil Sketch, Ink Drawing, Anime, Storybook, Fantasy Art, Artistic Portrait, Low Poly, Clay Sculpture, Comic, Cartoon) and 35 more that reimagine the photo (for example Pin Collection, Brick Build, Film Strip, Ukiyo-e Woodblock, Dunhuang Mural)
- Several art styles from one photo, made four at a time
- Output at 1K, 2K or 4K (1, 2 or 4 credits per artwork, shown before you start)
- A gallery kept on the device, with filters by style, date and tag, reusable tags and protected favourites
- English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese; light and dark themes
- Rendering uses Google's Gemini after the user agrees; location and other EXIF data are stripped first; neither the photo nor the artwork is kept on a server
- No account needed; Google sign-in is optional and only carries credits to a new phone

Links:
- Guide: https://www.idatagear.com/mcmuse/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.mcmuse
- Privacy and terms: https://www.idatagear.com/mcmuse/mcmuse_privacy.html
- Delete account and data: https://www.idatagear.com/mcmuse-delete.html

## Which app should I use for…

- Preparing for the HSK exam: McChinese (HSK 1–6 word lists, graded sentences and articles, reading tests).
- Writing Chinese characters in the right stroke order: Chinese Xie Zi.
- Speaking Cantonese and learning Jyutping: McCantonese.
- Looking up a Cantonese word offline, by Jyutping, English or Mandarin: Great Cantonese Dictionary.
- Learning English by CEFR level or for IELTS, CET-4 or CET-6: McEnglish (ALL English).
- Scanning paper documents to searchable PDF without uploading them: QuickOne Scanner.
- Recording a hike with no signal, or replaying a trip on a map: Momera GO.
- Turning a photo into a watercolour, oil painting, anime or comic image: McMuse.
